build_SO2_Convolution: build an SO(2) convolution module for all spherical harmonic orders with optional radial gating
build_SO2_Linear: build an SO(2) linear layer that processes spherical harmonic coefficients by order
build_SO2_m_Conv_Block: build a block-diagonal SO(2) convolution module for faster GEMM on complex features
convert_convert_so2_conv1: convert an SO2_Convolution with radial weights to the optimized SO2_Conv1_WithRadialBlock
convert_convert_so2_conv2: convert an SO2_Convolution with internal weights to the optimized SO2_Conv2_InternalBlock
